summary.intent: Complete a three-phase UAT audit gap-closure sprint (phases 42-44) for CipherBox — covering API unpin integrity, FUSE write durability, and IPNS conflict handling — using the GSD workflow manager with inline discuss, inline plan, and wave-based parallel execution.
summary.outcome: Phases 42 and 43 fully closed with all plans executed, code-reviewed, and verified. Phase 44 reached gap-closure wave dispatch (plans 44-06/44-07 created and committed, wave 4 executor just dispatched) with all 5 main plans complete and merged.

repo: The POST /ipfs/unpin endpoint is guarded only by JwtAuthGuard with no ownership check — any authenticated user (signup is open via Web3Auth) could unpin any CID; fixed in phase 42 with VaultService.guardedUnpin

Kubo runs with the 'server' profile and swarm port 4001 publicly exposed (docker/docker-compose.staging.yml:62-72), broadcasting DHT provider records for every pinned CID — CIDs are public identifiers by design
writable-share saves drop prunedCids without unpinning (shared-write.ts:450), so no legitimate cross-user unpin path exists

pnpm/jest filter flag bug: `pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api test -- --testPathPattern=X` silently breaks because pnpm inserts `--` before the jest args, making jest treat the pattern as a positional regex; correct form is `pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api exec jest --testPathPattern='X'`
pnpm api:generate must be run after any controller changes to regenerate openapi.json; omitting it causes a formatting-only diff that conflicts across worktrees

WinFsp cross-compilation (`cargo build -p cipherbox-fuse --features winfsp`) cannot pass on macOS due to pre-existing failures in windows-future and winfsp-sys registry crates — unrelated to phase 43 changes

Phase 44 changed updateFileMetadata's return shape: now returns {ipnsName, metadataCid, newSequenceNumber, prunedCids} instead of ipnsRecord; callers must drop the downstream batchPublishIpnsRecords call
gsd commit helper (`query commit`) is not reliable — returns `committed: false` as a false negative while the commit actually landed; always verify with `git log`
No .prettierignore existed before this session — prettier was mangling .planning/ markdown tables and GSD-controlled files; created and committed during phase 42 planning
Per-phase feat/ branches are managed automatically by GSD tooling; main and origin/main are never touched directly
Postgres advisory xact lock on `hashtext(cid)` closes the concurrent-unpin race window without a reconciliation job; drift report is detect-only (read-only, zero .delete( calls)

code.finding: Upload-compensation path called `ipfsProvider.unpinFile` directly (global Kubo pin/rm) — rerouted through guardedUnpin in phase 42 with a D-13 race window comment

guardedUnpin added: pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(cid)) → row delete + refcount in one transaction → insert pending_unpins if last reference → commit → Kubo pin/rm best-effort post-commit; cross-user attempts increment metric and return silent 2XX

handle_release ordering enforced: journal.put(844) → handle.cleanup(892) → reply.ok(894) → spawn(904) → journal.remove on success(943); the journal-fsync-before-ack pattern ensures no data loss on crash between OS ack and upload
Had a spurious journal.remove call in the background upload thread (CR-08 mirror) that was removed in phase 43 gap closure; authoritative cleanup path is replay_for_vault on next mount
Kubo v0.40 configured with 'server' profile and swarm port 4001 (tcp+udp) publicly exposed; server profile only disables local-network discovery, full DHT participation is kept
Phase 44 switched import from internal sdk to @cipherbox/sdk-core for updateFileMetadata; removed redundant replaceFileInFolder call and added baseChildren: parentFolder.children for three-way merge
writable-share saves drop prunedCids without unpinning — confirmed no legitimate cross-user unpin path; phase 44 also rewired file CAS return shape consumption here

workflow: 1Password SSH commit signing requires dangerouslyDisableSandbox: true on all git Bash calls; never use --no-gpg-sign as PRs enforce signatures
worktree.cleanup-wave must be run from the repo root, not from inside an agent worktree — running from a worktree causes false base_mismatch errors because the helper resolves repoRoot from cwd
cleanup-wave is not idempotent: already-merged entries report branch_mismatch on rerun; write reduced manifests containing only remaining unmerged entries for reruns
Untracked node_modules and .husky/_ directories in agent worktrees block the merge cleanup; remove them before running cleanup-wave
A worktree merge can complete conflict resolution but leave MERGE_HEAD if the commit step is interrupted; conclude with `git commit --no-edit` rather than restarting the merge
nest build has a side-effect of reformatting openapi.json in the main tree; restore with `git checkout --` before merging worktrees to avoid merge conflicts
RAM constraint in subagents: never run full monorepo test suites; always use targeted --testPathPattern or --filter patterns
GSD auto_advance: true chains plan → execute automatically; the plan-phase Skill call triggers execute-phase as its next step
When rebasing a downstream branch (e.g. feat/fuse-write-durability) onto a completed upstream phase branch, verify the rewritten commits carry SSH signatures with `git log --show-signature`
zsh multi-glob rm (`rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules`) aborts the entire command if any glob matches nothing; use individual explicit paths instead

friction: 1Password SSH signing failed mid-session multiple times with 'agent returned an error / fatal: failed to write commit object', requiring the user to manually restart the 1Password desktop app
gsd commit helper false negatives: tool returned `committed: false` while commits had actually landed, causing unnecessary retry attempts and wasted time
cleanup-wave not idempotent and not restartable: partial failures required manually constructing reduced manifests with only remaining unmerged worktree entries
cleanup-wave cwd sensitivity: helper resolved repoRoot from cwd, silently producing false base_mismatch errors when run from inside a worktree rather than the repo root
openapi.json formatting drift from nest build side-effects created spurious conflicts during wave 3 worktree merges, requiring manual restore before merging
Planner agent hit a socket error mid-execution after writing plans 42-01 through 42-03, requiring a filesystem check and a continuation planner agent for plans 04-08
Session quota limits (Europe/Berlin timezone) caused multiple mid-wave interruptions, losing background agent context and requiring worktree state inspection to recover
User accidentally typed 'touring wyatt web bossy' twice mid-execution, causing interruptions and requiring explicit 'please continue' recovery
Decision coverage gate D-07 failed due to a mechanical grep needing a literal `D-07:` citation in the plan's must_haves section — not a real coverage gap, just a formatting requirement
prettier was silently mangling .planning/ markdown tables (converting pipe-escaped regex in VALIDATION.md into table columns) because no .prettierignore existed
42-05 merge left MERGE_HEAD after auto-resolving all conflicts but failing the commit step, requiring `git commit --no-edit` to conclude rather than being handled by the cleanup helper
